settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose the language used throughout the app. Follow device uses your system preference.
settings.resetFooter: Permanently deletes every reptile and activity record stored on this device. Your language setting will not change.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.exportFooter: Backups are standard ZIP files containing your selected data and WebP photos.
backup.restoreFooter: Restoring a backup replaces its included data. A reptiles-and-records backup replaces your current reptiles and records; a preferences-only backup keeps them.
backup.restoreMessage_one: This backup has {{animals}} reptile and {{records}} record. It will replace your current reptiles and records.
backup.restoreMessage_other: This backup has {{animals}} reptiles and {{records}} records. It will replace your current reptiles and records.
backup.restoreError: Could not restore this backup. Please try again.

defaults.globalFooter: What a new log sheet opens on, and how weights are shown everywhere. Each reptile follows these unless it overrides them.
defaults.animalFooter: Applies to {{animalName}} only. Rows left on Follow global track your Settings.
defaults.animalFooterNew: Applies to this reptile only. Rows left on Follow global track your Settings.
